title: feat(state-diagram): implement neo look
description:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR implements Neo look support for **State Diagrams**, extending the Neo look system to state diagram visualizations with modern styling, enhanced theming support, and comprehensive test coverage.

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

### State node shapes (neo look)
- **Start/end nodes:** `stateStart.ts` and `stateEnd.ts` render start/end circles with neo-aware sizing. Fallback sets `node.height = 14` when missing (fixes previous `node.width` copy-paste). Drop-shadow is driven by a **`nodeShadow` theme variable** (set on redux themes) instead of `theme?.includes('redux')`, so shared shapes stay theme-agnostic.
- **End state inner circle:** Inner circle radius in `stateEnd.ts` is scaled from the node size (`innerNodeRadius = (node.width * 5) / 14`) so the ratio stays consistent across sizes.
- **Regular state nodes:** `state.ts` supports neo look so state boxes align with the shared neo styling.
---
### Markers and edges
- **Neo arrow marker:** New **`barbNeo`** marker (and `barbEnd-margin`) is used for state diagram neo look. The shared **`barb`** marker is unchanged (still `refX: 19`) so other diagram types are not affected.
- **Theme variable for arrows:** `barbNeo` uses **`transitionColor`** from theme variables (not `archEdgeArrowColor`) so state diagrams use the correct semantic color.
- **Edge offset:** `getLineFunctionsWithOffset` applies an arrow/barb offset for neo look so transition lines and arrow heads align correctly.
---
### Themes
- **`nodeShadow`:** All four redux theme files (`theme-redux.js`, `theme-redux-dark.js`, `theme-redux-color.js`, `theme-redux-dark-color.js`) set **`nodeShadow = true`** so start/end nodes can get the small drop-shadow when the theme opts in, without hardcoding theme names in shapes.
---
### Styles
- **State diagram styles:** `styles.js` uses a **theme-driven `strokeWidth`** (from options) instead of a hardcoded value, so neo look can control transition line thickness via the theme.
---
